metadata.title: SplitCord — Personal Drive powered by Discord
metadata.description: Store and manage your files via Discord with SplitCord's chunking system.

setup.headline: Your personal Drive powered by Discord
setup.subheadline: Upload, organize and download your files through a Google Drive‑like interface. Discord stores the data, SplitCord orchestrates everything.

storage.title: Unlimited storage
storage.description: Use Discord as a file backend with no limit.

chunking.title: Smart chunking
chunking.description: Files automatically split into 7.5 MB segments.

manifest.title: .radis manifest
manifest.description: Proprietary format to faithfully reconstruct your files.

form.title: Configure your webhook
form.subtitle: Enter your Discord webhook URL to get started.
form.label: Discord Webhook URL
form.privacy: Your webhook URL is stored locally in your browser.

guide.toggle: How do I get my Discord webhook URL?
guide.step2Title: Create a webhook on a dedicated channel
guide.step2Desc: Click "New Webhook", select a dedicated channel (e.g. #splitcord-storage), and give it a name.
guide.step3Desc: Click "Copy Webhook URL" and paste it in the field above.
guide.tip: Tip: Create a private channel visible only to you. Uploaded files will be stored in that channel as attachments.

empty.title: Your Drive is empty
empty.description: Upload your first files. They will be split into chunks and stored on Discord via your webhook.
empty.dragHint: Or drag and drop files anywhere on the page

delete.title: Delete file
delete.description: This will permanently delete {name} along with all its Discord messages ({count, plural, =1 {# chunk} other {# chunks}}). This action is irreversible.
